name: SandM - Yuri to Suzuri no Baai. -
original_name: SandM - 有栞と鈴梨の場合。-
source:
Suddenly, a pair of pretty girls drew near me, demanding to choose one of them. So I chose a girl......

This is a love-triangle story of you, Suzuri (selfish, with little breast), and Yuri (gentle, with big breast).

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ027989.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
突然，一对漂亮的女孩靠近我，要求选一个。所以我选择了一个女孩……

这是你、铃里（自私、小胸）和尤里（温柔、大胸）的三角爱情故事。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ027989.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
